description: 臺灣地區國際商港進港船舶按地區分 [ports and harbours] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 臺灣港務股份有限公司. 單位：艘次(同一船舶進港及出港，分別各計1艘次。 )國際商港：包含基隆港、台北港、蘇澳港、台中港、高雄港、安平港、花蓮港。. Coverage: Taiwan. The portal files it under the publisher 臺灣港務股份有限公司. Its tags are 交通及通訊. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2025-02-05 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support port and shipping studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
